headline: Permitless Carry signed into law in Alabama
snippet: 22nd constitutional carry state. No permit needed for concealed pistol, effective Jan 1 2023.

headline: Alabama Senate Judiciary Committee approves permitless carry bill
snippet: Sponsor Rep. Stringer was fired from Mobile County Sheriff's Dept for championing the bill.

headline: Alabama sheriffs speak out against proposed permitless carry bill
snippet: Sheriffs Association opposed, citing traffic stop safety and permit fee revenue loss.
